# BRIEF 29 — CERTIFIED REPORT (user-generated, evidence-signed, tamper-evident)

**GATE: Brief 26 ZK custody proven in production (capture-time plaintext commitments must exist).**
**Amendment to Brief 27. The report is the SURVIVOR'S — generated by her, for her, on her command. The org and
operator are never in the path and never receive it.**

---

## §-1 — NON-NEGOTIABLE CONSTRAINTS (read first — this governs the whole brief)

**THE SYSTEM MUST WORK EXACTLY AS IT DOES NOW AFTER THIS BRIEF. This is purely additive.**

- `[A]` **Touches NOTHING that exists.** No change to trigger, capture, closure, dispatch, notification, accounts,
  tenancy, entitlement, the encryption envelope, or the intake flow. Not one line of any existing path.
- `[A]` **Reuses, never re-implements.** The signature uses the **existing** Brief 26 capture-commitment chain
  and crypto primitives. It does **not** introduce a second crypto stack, a second key system, or a parallel
  verification of anything the system already verifies. If it needs a primitive, it imports the one already
  shipped.
- `[A]` **The verifier is NOT an independent verification system.** It verifies the report document only. It does
  **not** re-verify captures, events, custody, or anything the platform already attests internally. It is a
  read-only checker of one signed artifact — nothing in the running system depends on it, calls it, or changes
  because of it.
- `[A]` **Fully behind the flag.** Gated on `ENVELOPE_ENCRYPTION_ENABLED`. Flag off (today) ⇒ this brief is inert
  and the system is byte-identical to before it existed.
- `[A]` **The verification page is a leaf.** A standalone static+worker endpoint at `/verification`. Nothing in
  the app imports it, routes through it, or waits on it. If the page were deleted tomorrow, the app runs
  unchanged and documents remain independently verifiable by the published key.
- `[A]` **Full acceptance suite green, unchanged, after this brief.** Every existing check still passes. This
  brief only *adds* rows; it removes and modifies none.

---

## §0 — THE PRINCIPLE

The report's authority comes from **verifiable cryptography, not from BLACK BOX's word.** Anyone — a court, an
advocate, a police intake officer — can verify it themselves, independent of BLACK BOX. That independence is the
trust. BLACK BOX is not asking to be believed; it is providing a record that can be checked.

**Two zones, two trust levels, in one document:**

| Zone | Source | Signed | Editable |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Evidence** | System metadata + on-device decryption of her own capture | **YES — cryptographically** | **No — any change is detectable** |
| **Statement** | Her own words, her context | No — and correctly so | Hers entirely |

The evidence zone must be trustworthy without being frozen-by-force. Her statement must be hers without being
machine-judged. The signature covers the first and deliberately not the second.

---

## §1 — GENERATION FLOW (all on her device)

1. She taps **Start a report.** Nothing happens without this.
2. **Generic details auto-populate** — account/event metadata (timestamps, location, duration, notifications
   sent, coordinator engagement, closure). Factual system record.
3. **Evidence summary is built from on-device decryption of her own capture** — she unwraps her capture with her
   own key, locally; the tool assembles a **timestamped, chunked event summary** from the decrypted data. The
   server never reads it. This is the ZK line: decryption is hers, on her device, with her key.
4. **The evidence zone is signed** (see §2) and carries a visible **BLACK BOX CERTIFIED** mark.
5. **Statement section** — her own words, guided at her pace (Brief 27 §3 FETI prompts), the human context the
   evidence cannot hold. Not signed. Fully hers.
6. **Download**, with the §4 custody caution.

- `[A]` Auto-population is **opt-in per report** — offered after she taps report, never pre-filled before.
- `[A]` The evidence summary derives from the **capture-time plaintext commitments** (Brief 26), so the summary
  provably corresponds to what was recorded — not a re-interpretation.
- `[A]` **No AI assertion anywhere in the evidence zone.** The summary is a deterministic rendering of decrypted
  data + metadata. No model writes a fact about the incident. (Brief 27 §3 rule, absolute here.)

## §2 — THE SIGNATURE (what "CERTIFIED → TAMPERED" actually is)

**Not prevention — detection.** A downloaded file is bytes; anyone holding it can alter any byte. We do not claim
to stop that. We make any alteration to the **evidence zone** mathematically detectable, at which point BLACK BOX
no longer vouches for it.

- On generation, BLACK BOX computes a hash over the **evidence zone only** and **signs it** with the BLACK BOX
  signing key, chained to the capture-time commitments.
- The document embeds: the signature, the capture-commitment references, and a verification pointer to
  **https://www.blackboxsentinel.com/verification**.
- The **statement zone is excluded from the signed hash** — she may revise her account without invalidating the
  certification, and a court is told the statement is her account, not machine-verified.
- `[A]` The signing key is **server-side, guarded, and signing is a discrete authenticated step.** A leaked
  signing key means forgeable certifications — protect it accordingly. Sign server-side over a hash computed on
  her device; the document content need not leave her device in plaintext to be signed (sign the hash, not the
  content) — confirm this preserves ZK at the crypto-review gate.

## §3 — THE VERIFICATION PAGE (https://www.blackboxsentinel.com/verification)

Public. Anyone can verify without an account and without contacting BLACK BOX.

- Drop the file in (or scan its QR). The page re-hashes the evidence zone and checks the signature against BLACK
  BOX's **published public key.**
- **Match → "BLACK BOX CERTIFIED — evidence verified, unaltered since generation [date]."**
- **Any change to the evidence zone → "TAMPERED — this document's evidence has been altered and is not certified
  by BLACK BOX."**
- The statement zone is reported separately: **"Survivor statement — her account, not machine-verified"** — never
  flagged as tampered for being edited.
- `[A]` **The verifier never stores the uploaded document.** It hashes, checks, discards. Verification is public;
  the content is not. State this on the page.
- `[A]` Verification works **offline-documentable** too: publish the public key and the algorithm so a court's own
  expert can verify independently of the page ever existing. The page is convenience; the math is the trust.

## §4 — THE CUSTODY CAUTION (before download)

> **Once you download this report, we can no longer protect its privacy.**
> On your device or sent to someone, it becomes a file you control — it can be seen by anyone with access to it,
> and it is no longer under BLACK BOX's sealed custody. Its authenticity stays verifiable. Its privacy is now
> yours to manage.

- `[A]` Shown before the file is produced. Informs, never discourages. A downloadable report is her having power
  over her own evidence — that is the point.

## §5 — GUARDS

- `[A]` The report is generated on her device, from her key. Org and operator are never in the path and never
  receive it.
- `[A]` Evidence zone: no AI, deterministic, signed, chained to capture commitments.
- `[A]` Statement zone: hers, unsigned, editable, never machine-judged.
- `[A]` §0a: report generation is Visible/Settings-side only — never in the Hidden facade.
- `[A]` Gated on `ENVELOPE_ENCRYPTION_ENABLED` — no report path exists while ZK is off (no plaintext-capture
  report).

## DONE
A survivor-generated report she builds on her own device from her own decrypted evidence — a signed, tamper-
evident evidence zone that any third party can verify as CERTIFIED or TAMPERED against BLACK BOX's published key,
plus her own unsigned statement — downloadable with an honest custody caution, org and operator never in the path.
The trust is in the verifiable math, not in BLACK BOX's word. Committed and pushed; both deploy halves currency-
asserted; the verification page live at /verification; phone sign-off.

**Crypto-review gate item:** confirm signing a device-computed hash (not the content) preserves zero-knowledge,
and ratify the signing-key custody + publication of the verification public key.
